Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649957. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and join assays on assay_id. Filter where assays.chembl_id equals CHEMBL4649957, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
